questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: The academic opportunities, the location and classes. It was also crucial that it was a English speaking country

Additional comments:

questions.answer: It was okay easy

questions.answer: I needed help from UCSB to find housing

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: We didn’t really have any orientation due to covid

questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.answer: It was very difficult to find housing on and off campus.

questions.answer: That it is way more expensive than in Copenhagen

Additional comments:

questions.answer: Don’t know if any help was available?

questions.answer: I did almost get all the classes I wanted

questions.answer: Food was more expensive than expected due to the lack of a big supermarket near UCSB.

Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: More or less everything. Sport, trips, events, clubs etc.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I will recommend UCSB excursion club. For 30$ can you pick up surfboards, SUP, kayaks and join events and trips for now fee.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Travel if possible. Visit the mountains around Santa Barbara and hike to the hot springs.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Easy, but people are a bit younger than at KU

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Join the UCSB excursion club.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: I didn’t find any cultural differences particularly challenging

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: How outgoing everyone is

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
It is expensive 
It has good classes that is not possible to get at KU
It is a lot of fun
